name: create_repeating_calendar_event
description: Creates a repeating/recurring calendar event using RRULE format.
arguments_prompt:
An interval calendar event requires the following arguments:

Required Fields:
- **event_name**: The title of the event (e.g., "Daily Standup Meeting").
- **start**: The start date and time of the first occurrence, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (ISO 8601).
- **end**: The end date and time of the first occurrence, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`. Must be later than `start`.
- **recurrence_rule**: Defines the recurrence pattern using [RFC 5545](https://icalendar.org/iCalendar-RFC-5545/3-8-5-3-recurrence-rule.html). Examples:
  - `RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10` (Daily for 10 occurrences)
  - `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;UNTIL=2024-12-31T23:59:59` (Weekly until a specific date)
  - `RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;COUNT=6` (Monthly for 6 months)
  - `RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=12;BYMONTHDAY=30` (Every December 30th)

Optional Fields:
- **calendar_name**: The calendar to create the event in (e.g., "primary", "Birthdays", "Work", "Family"). Defaults to "primary".
- **all_day**: Set to true for all-day events (no specific time, just a date). Defaults to false. When true, start/end should still be provided but times will be ignored.
- **time_zone**: The time zone for the event (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles"). Defaults to PST if not specified.
- **description**: A detailed description of the event (e.g., "A daily sync to discuss progress").
- **location**: The physical or virtual location of the event (e.g., "Conference Room A" or "https://zoom.us/my/meeting").
- **link**: A URL for the meeting or event materials.
- **participants**: A list of participants, each with a name and email (e.g., `[{"name": "John Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com"}]`).
- **flexibility**: How moveable this event is. "fixed" (default), "flexible", "soft_block", or "aspirational".
- **blocking**: True (default) blocks time on calendar, False shows as available.

Example 1 (Timed Event):
{ "event_name": "Daily Standup Meeting", "start": "2024-11-15T09:00:00", "end": "2024-11-15T09:15:00", "time_zone": "America/Los_Angeles", "recurrence_rule": "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10", "location": "Online via Zoom", "link": "https://zoom.us/my/standup", "participants": [ {"name": "John Doe", "email": "john.doe@example.com"}, {"name": "Jane Smith", "email": "jane.smith@example.com"} ] }

Example 2 (All-Day Birthday):
{ "event_name": "Jaime's Birthday", "start": "2025-12-30T00:00:00", "end": "2025-12-31T00:00:00", "calendar_name": "Birthdays", "all_day": true, "recurrence_rule": "RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=12;BYMONTHDAY=30", "description": "Birthday celebration" }

Example 3 (Yearly Event):
{ "event_name": "Annual Planning Retreat", "start": "2025-01-15T08:00:00", "end": "2025-01-15T17:00:00", "time_zone": "America/Chicago", "recurrence_rule": "RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;UNTIL=2028-01-15T17:00:00", "description": "An annual retreat to plan company goals and strategies.", "link": null, "participants": [ {"name": "CEO", "email": "ceo@example.com"}, {"name": "COO", "email": "coo@example.com"} ] }

Important!
Figure out what fields have been provided for you.  If a field is missing, leave it blank.  It is very rare that more than few fields are filled.
If a location is not mentioned explicitly, do not fill it in.  Do not invent extra fields that are not there!  Do not hallucinate things that are not given.

Avoid ambiguity at midnight: Times exactly at 00:00:00 can be misinterpreted as either the start or end of a day. When setting boundaries, explicitly choose 23:59:59 (end of the previous day) or 00:01:00 (start of the new day) for clarity.
